title: A–B friction coefficient
description: Essential: Correctly calculates μ_AB = 0.2 from spring reading and normal force on A.

title: B–ground friction coefficient
description: Essential: Correctly calculates μ_Bg = 0.1 from force balance on B and total normal force.

title: Force balance on A
description: Important: Identifies that spring force equals kinetic friction between A and B.

title: Force balance on B
description: Important: Applies Newton's first law to B, equating applied force to sum of friction forces from A and ground.

title: Constant velocity reasoning
description: Important: Recognizes that constant velocity implies zero net force on each object.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Uses consistent units (N, kg, m/s²) and shows correct dimensional analysis.

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies direction of friction forces on B, leading to incorrect force equation.

title: Normal force mistake
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong normal force (e.g., only m_B*g for ground friction) in either coefficient formula.
